confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is uncertain for July peak season. Cluj-Napoca is priced above the rest of Romania because of tourism and the tech sector. FX came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview for 15 Oct 2026; I did not independently read that page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Romanian and Central European university cities with similar tourism demand, adjusted upward from the national Romanian level for Cluj's premium. No web search was used for the city-price anchors.
